acceptance_criteria: task run TASK_ID --pause-after-current atomically arms the pending pause before returning successful detached ownership
the returned launch result still requires END_TURN_IMMEDIATELY and reports the armed pause
no second pause command is required after launch
child terminal publication leaves the current task AWAITING_SUPERVISOR and the supervisor evaluable rather than prematurely PAUSED
accept or reject records the decision before PAUSE_AFTER_CURRENT_APPLIED and then reaches PAUSED with no next child
the existing non-atomic compatibility pause command remains available
temporary fixture dispatcher cleanup cannot race recursive fixture removal

may: modify task-run control flow, detached launch result, directly related tests, and operations documentation
run focused and full local verification
may_not: invoke live wake, signal live runtime, replay or rewrite historical events
change canonical wake message or argv, policy, identity, session binding, host configuration, or decision ordering
modify siblings, push, merge, deploy, install, or initialize a repository

expected_deliverable: Atomic detached pause arming, ordering regressions, deterministic fixture cleanup, and concise operations documentation.
objective: Reconcile pause-after-current with the detached dormancy boundary. Add an atomic detached launch option that persists pause-after-current before successful Runner ownership is returned, so the supervisor can obey END_TURN_IMMEDIATELY without issuing a second command. Preserve evaluation-before-PAUSED ordering and make detached test-fixture dispatcher cleanup deterministic.
relevant_context: After detached ownership, the supervisor must end its turn immediately and perform no follow-up command or check.
The legacy task run followed by pause --after-current sequence now violates that boundary.
Pause must remain pending through child completion, allow supervisor evaluation, apply PAUSED only after accept or reject, and block the next child.
An independent focused rerun exposed ENOTEMPTY while a temporary fixture dispatcher was exiting; cleanup must become deterministic without weakening production dispatch.
scope: src/runner.js detached launch result if needed
tests/detached-runner.test.js atomic pause ordering and cleanup
